mapper.select: select , m.name member_name from reading_plan p join member m on m.id = p.member_id where p.member_id = #{memberId}
select , m.name member_name from reading_plan p join member m on m.id = p.member_id where p.member_id = #{memberId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into reading_plan(member_id, name, description, target_books, start_date, end_date, status, version) values(#{memberId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{targetBooks}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: update reading_plan set name = #{r.name}, description = #{r.description}, target_books = #{r.targetBooks}, start_date = #{r.startDate}, end_date = #{r.endDate}, status = #{r.status}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() where member_id = #{memberId} and version = #{r.version}
mapper.delete: delete from reading_plan where member_id = #{memberId} and version = #{version}
